# Gabriele Compagni

> Official website of Gabriele Compagni, an Italian photographer and video director working internationally across fashion editorials, commercial campaigns, portraits, athletes, film, and personal art projects.

Gabriele Compagni works across Milan, New York, and international locations. His practice combines photography and moving image, with an emphasis on form, imperfection, sensitivity, and the unpredictability of human encounters.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://gabrielecompagni.com/): Introduction and main navigation.
- [Portfolio](https://gabrielecompagni.com/portfolio.html): Selected photography and filmmaking.
- [Biography](https://gabrielecompagni.com/bio.html): Background, artistic practice, clients, publications, celebrities, and athletes.
- [New York](https://gabrielecompagni.com/newyork.html): Availability and production enquiries in New York.

## Selected projects

- [MOJEH Special Gucci](https://gabrielecompagni.com/projects/mojeh-gucci.html): Fashion editorial photographed for MOJEH Special Gucci.
- [Luka Modric](https://gabrielecompagni.com/projects/luka-modric.html): Portrait project photographed for the global Kalshi campaign.
